description: Generate a new secret for a deployed workflow's webhook trigger, redeploy it, and return the new secret. This immediately breaks anything still calling the webhook with the old secret, so only do it when the user asks or needs the secret to call the webhook themselves. The new secret takes a few seconds to go live: treat a single 401 right afterwards as propagation delay, wait and retry, and do not rotate again. Refused if the owner turned off deploys for this connection.

workflowId.description: The workflow's id, from list_workflows or create_workflow.

name: rotate_webhook_secret
title: Rotate webhook secret
